limitations: All words of length <= 9 (aab -> ababa, maximal derivation 127 = 2^7 - 1) and <= 12 (aab -> babaa, maximal 62) reach normal forms; no linear interpretation (coefficients <= 7), weighted factor count (|f| <= 4) or self-embedding (seeds <= 10, depth 30) was found.
novelty_basis: Both rules are right barren in McNaughton's sense, and barren one-rule systems terminate (McNaughton; A. Geser, ICASE Report 2002-33, Thm 3.2-3.3); the lab's proof is independent and also gives the exact complexities (CLM-C20-01/02).

statement:
The one-rule systems aab -> ababa and aab -> babaa over {a,b} (and their images under reversal and
letter exchange) are terminating.
title: The rules aab -> ababa and aab -> babaa (and their six symmetric images) terminate
